item.title: A Language Model That Doesn't Use PyTorch, Hand-written in Rust: 12x Faster Generation? I Almost Believed My Own 98x
item.description: PSSA is a 21MB repo: selective SSM loop + hyperbolic memory bank + fast-weight online updates, no PyTorch. The author says 12x faster; the in-body table says 4.13x. On my box, char-normalized it's 9.3x — and I caught the 98x fake-number trap: throughput computed on the nominal token ceiling makes the two sides' workload fundamentally incomparable. twin_check reproduces 3e-8 locally; every command re-runnable.
